Amiable Beloved
Can dear Eyes feel great hope in joy kindling lonely Margaretta’s notions of procuring quarters reposefully secure through united votes with xpressed youthful zeal - ?

The alphabet will not serve me to express that I never gave [you](../persons.html#749) the direction to the lady who will try to get votes for [Miss Erle](../persons.html#2010), and here it is.[^1] [Mamma](../persons.html#1606) is very well and bright.

The Chair is to be sent for to be inspected at home
your affectionate

C M Yonge
The address is
[Miss Carter Smith](../persons.html#263)
8 Wellington Road
Charlton

[^1]: Jacob is evidently seeking the admission of Miss Erle, whose first name was presumably Margaretta or Margaret, to a home for incurables. CMY had a subscriber\'s vote at the [Royal Hospital for Incurables](../others.html#37), but the [Home for Incurable and Infirm Women](../others.html#26) is another possibility.
